title: Healing at the Pool of Bethesda
theme: Jesus' healing at Bethesda contrasts His compassion with apathy and criticism and confirms His divine authority.
proposition: The healing at Bethesda demonstrates Jesus' compassion and divinity and calls us to compassionate, faithful action rather than apathy.
sermonQuestion: What do we see and learn in Jesus' healing at the pool of Bethesda?

outline.heading: AT THE POOL OF BETHESDA WE SEE AN UNREALIZED CURE
AT THE POOL OF BETHESDA WE SEE AN UNABASHED COMMAND
AT THE POOL OF BETHESDA WE SEE AN UNJUSTIFIED CRITICISM
AT THE POOL OF BETHESDA WE SEE AN UNAPOLOGETIC CONFIRMATION
